description: Saved Writing rewrite and preservation cases.

cases.name: meaningful negation inside formulaic framing
cases.text: Here's the thing: the scheduler isn't slow because of Python. It's slow because each job opens three database connections. Let that sink in.
cases.rewrite: The scheduler is slow because each job opens three database connections, not because of Python.
rewrite_preserve: each job opens three database connections
preserve: each job opens three database connections

cases.name: modality quantity and version boundary
cases.text: The patch will probably reduce median latency by about 12%, but it may fail on kernels older than 5.10.
cases.rewrite: The patch will probably reduce median latency by about 12%, but it may fail on kernels older than 5.10.

cases.name: verbatim passive quotation

cases.name: dialect profanity and speaker voice
cases.text: I ain't gonna pretend this shit worked; y'all saw it crash twice.

cases.name: legitimate passive voice
cases.text: The samples were stored at −80 °C before analysis.

cases.name: meaning-bearing triad

cases.name: watched words in precise domain senses
cases.text: The prediction market rewards accurate forecasts; the browser navigates to the results in landscape orientation.

cases.name: genuinely formulaic paragraph with real content
cases.text: Here's the thing: modern teams need to move fast. It's not just about speed; it's about clarity. Clear plans, crisp feedback, confident execution. Let that sink in.
cases.rewrite: Modern teams need speed, clarity, clear plans, crisp feedback, and confident execution.
